{{Otheruses|Algae}}
'''Algae cylinders''' were a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Air scrubber/Legends|air scrubber]] that scrubbed the [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] within a ship over a special [[Carbon dioxide/Legends|carbon dioxide]]-eating [[Algae/Legends|algae]] that created more breathable air.<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]</ref>
